tools.name: fbook_set_booking_status
tools.description: Update a booking's status via a single-field status update (PUT /schedules/{id}). Accepted statuses: scheduled, completed, cancelled, rejected, no_show. Pass reason (sent as cancel_reason or reject_reason) for cancelled/rejected — the API reads it raw so an empty string is sent when omitted. Pass refund_payment=true to trigger a refund for cancelled/rejected bookings. Pass update_all=true to bulk-update a multi-guest group for no_show/completed. Note: the API rejects setting a value equal to the current one ("No changes found").

reason.description: Reason used as cancel_reason (cancelled) or reject_reason (rejected).

refund_payment.description: Trigger a payment refund; only honoured for cancelled/rejected.

update_all.description: Bulk-update all guests in a multi-guest group; only honoured for no_show/completed.

Use "extra" to merge additional fields first.

is_display_spots.description: 0 or 1 — whether to show remaining spots (required for group events).

settings.description: Event settings object (e.g. multi_duration). Does NOT update availability schedules or booking limits — those are separate endpoints (use fbook_request).

extra.description: Additional fields merged into the request body first.

tools.name: fflow_set_variable

Refuses syteops_* names (those are SyteOps-managed — use syteops_dispatch variables.set). Refuses values starting with "PHP:" unless allow_php:true (FlowMattic eval()s such values at runtime).

tools.name: fflow_set_workflow_status

Registers the trigger correctly for ALL trigger types: webhook/integration-event run on activation with no extra setup; schedule/polling register a WP-Cron event; plugin-action hooks register their dynamic hook. Closes the gap where workflows had to be toggled in the FlowMattic UI.

dry_run.description: If true, preview this destructive action without executing it.

tools.name: fflow_trigger_workflow
tools.description: Trigger a FlowMattic workflow on demand by numeric "id" or "key", posting an optional JSON "payload" to its webhook capture URL. The workflow must be active (status on) and its trigger must be a webhook — event-triggered workflows fire on their own event, not on demand. Returns a run acknowledgement; the workflow then runs asynchronously in the background.

key.description: SyteWide logical key of a provisioned workflow, or the FlowMattic workflow_id string (alternative to id).

payload.description: JSON body delivered to the workflow webhook.

dry_run.description: If true, preview this destructive action without executing it.

tools.name: fflow_update_workflow

If the workflow was built in FlowMattic's visual (v2) canvas, the rewrite emits a v1 flat graph: it still runs and re-lays-out when reopened, but loses saved canvas positioning (a warning is returned). The result includes a "previous" snapshot (before/after).

actions.description: New actions: [ { app, action, config?, connect_id? } ].

allow_php.description: Permit executable PHP config (php-functions/code apps or PHP: values); default false.
